show.name: La primera vez
show.summary: A mysterious teen girl arrives at an all-boys school in 1970s Colombia, breaking stereotypes, rules... and a few hearts.

episodes.name: Lisístrata
episodes.summary: Upon Eva's arrival, her classmates — particularly Camilo — take to her "teachings" and musings. But not everyone is warm and welcoming.

episodes.name: La dama de las camelias
episodes.summary: Suspecting Eva is too good to be true, the guys investigate her, but it's they who end up exposed. The gang has a life-altering, first-time experience.

episodes.name: Retrato del artista adolescente
episodes.summary: Upon hearing Eva might leave the school, the guys huddle and devise a scheme to help her stay… ultimately setting the stage for an explosive scene.

episodes.name: Una habitación propia
episodes.summary: Eva makes a strong impression on Camilo's parents. The group's clandestine project gets Camilo and Eva suspended. Pabón receives devastating news.

episodes.name: La letra escarlata
episodes.summary: With Estela's word against Mr. Pabón's, Camilo and Eva must dig deeper to find out the truth — all amidst hefty accusations and arguments.

episodes.name: Siddhartha
episodes.summary: Camilo's suspicions about Eva's story deepen. He offers to help her with her grades but she has other plans — which pierce a dagger in his heart.

episodes.name: Tess d'Urbervilles
episodes.summary: After a night of drinking, Eva lets intimate details of her life slip out, prompting Camilo to ask Arbeláez to keep a close eye on her.

episodes.name: Las penas de amor del joven Werther
episodes.summary: Protests in the streets cause tension amongst the group and in Camilo's home. Camilo proceeds with a Machiavellian plan to make Eva jealous.

episodes.name: Así habló Zaratustra
episodes.summary: Camilo finds himself in a tricky position, but one where he can finally express his feelings. There's only one problem: the recipient of his affection.

episodes.name: Las enseñanzas de don Juan
episodes.summary: Eva comes to Camilo's rescue. Martín blames Eva for the group's constant feuding. A party seemingly gone awry opens a window of opportunity for Camilo.

episodes.name: De profundis
episodes.summary: Camilo's dad's plan to take him to see a priest backfires. Martín opens up like never before. The gang must say goodbye to a dear friend.

episodes.name: Jungla de asfalto
episodes.summary: Eva and Camilo have a blast getting into mischief. Camilo shows just how far he'll go to protect Eva, finally finding the key to her heart.

episodes.name: El guardián entre el centeno
episodes.summary: While his parents navigate their roughest patch, Camilo enjoys his sunniest days with Eva. But will their love survive the gloomy horizon?
